0:
dir=/var/lib/matchbox/assets/fedora-coreos
base="https://builds.coreos.fedoraproject.org/prod/streams/$FCOS_STREAM/builds/$FCOS_VERSION/x86_64"
mkdir -p "$dir"
for kind in live-kernel.x86_64 live-initramfs.x86_64.img live-rootfs.x86_64.img; do
  file="fedora-coreos-$FCOS_VERSION-$kind"
  rm -f "$dir/$file" "$dir/$file.sig"
  coreos-installer download --fetch-retries 3 -C "$dir" -u "$base/$file"
  ln -sfn "$file" "$dir/${kind%.x86_64*}${kind#*.x86_64}"
done
echo "$FCOS_VERSION" > "$dir/VERSION"
ls -l "$dir"
if [ -f apps/ploeg/go.mod ]; then test -z "$(gofmt -l apps/ploeg)"; fi

set -eu
spec="$$1"
grep -q '"title": "\[canary\]' "$$spec" || exec cat "$$spec"
briefed=0
if [ -n "$${PLOEG_KNOWLEDGE_DIR:-}" ]; then
  briefed=$$(grep -rl ploeg-canary-note "$$PLOEG_KNOWLEDGE_DIR" | wc -l)
fi
printf '{"type":"Fact","title":"ploeg-canary-note","description":"Written while a canary Run worked","tags":["ploeg-canary"],"body":"ploeg-canary-note briefed=%s"}\n' "$$briefed" >> "$${PLOEG_NOTES_FILE:?no notes file: live notes are off}"
sleep 15
printf '{"outcome":"stuck","summary":"ploeg-canary stopped on purpose","stuckReason":"ploeg-canary stops every Run so the stop note is written"}\n' > "$$(dirname "$$spec")/outcome.json"
if [ -f apps/ploeg/go.mod ]; then test -z "$(gofmt -l apps/ploeg)"; fi

set -eu
spec="$$1"
grep -q '"title": "\[canary\]' "$$spec" || exec cat "$$spec"
briefed=0
if [ -n "$${PLOEG_KNOWLEDGE_DIR:-}" ]; then
  briefed=$$(grep -rl ploeg-canary-note "$$PLOEG_KNOWLEDGE_DIR" | wc -l)
fi
printf '{"type":"Fact","title":"ploeg-canary-note","description":"Written while a canary Run worked","tags":["ploeg-canary"],"body":"ploeg-canary-note briefed=%s"}\n' "$$briefed" >> "$${PLOEG_NOTES_FILE:?no notes file: live notes are off}"
sleep 15
printf '{"outcome":"stuck","summary":"ploeg-canary stopped on purpose","stuckReason":"ploeg-canary stops every Run so the stop note is written"}\n' > "$$(dirname "$$spec")/outcome.json"

set -eu
src_dir=/config
dst_dir=/home/steam/Zomboid/Server
mkdir -p "$dst_dir"
for src_file in "$src_dir"/*; do
  [ -e "$src_file" ] || continue
  cp -f "$src_file" "$dst_dir/$(basename "$src_file")"
done
